summary.prose: Building Story s1 means adding four small, purely-additive plain-data types and two pure, synchronous functions to one existing file (src/workflow/artifact-core/types.ts), with no I/O and no changes to any existing code. The work is almost entirely new surface area with a matching set of unit tests; nothing here touches a file any other Story or system already depends on.

tasks.title: Add Locator, Pointer, StalenessResult and PathValidationResult interfaces to src/workflow/artifact-core/types.ts
tasks.summary: Add a new, clearly-labeled section (e.g. '// --- shared-reviewcontext-data-model Epic sc1/sc2/sc6 (Locator/Pointer/staleness/path-validation), owned by s1 ---') at the end of src/workflow/artifact-core/types.ts defining: type LocatorKind = 'symbol' | 'lineRange' | 'docSection'; interface Locator { kind, value }; interface Pointer { path, section?, contentHash? }; interface StalenessResult { stale, checkedAt }; interface PathValidationResult { ok, violations }. No functions in this Task -- types only.
acceptanceChecks: Locator, Pointer, StalenessResult and PathValidationResult are exported from src/workflow/artifact-core/types.ts with exactly the field shapes the LLD's dataModelChanges describe
The new section is labeled unambiguously with this Epic's own name, not a bare 'sc1/sc2/sc6' that could be confused with this file's existing, differently-scoped sc-labeled sections
tsc typechecks the file with no errors

tests.name: Locator, Pointer, StalenessResult and PathValidationResult are exported with the exact documented field shapes

tasks.title: Implement PointerStalenessCheck and PointerPathValidator as pure functions
tasks.summary: Add type PointerStalenessCheck = (pointer, currentContentHash) => StalenessResult and type PointerPathValidator = (pointer, registeredRepoRoot) => PathValidationResult, each with a concrete implementing function, exported beside the types from t1. PointerStalenessCheck does a plain string comparison (no I/O); PointerPathValidator resolves pointer.path against registeredRepoRoot via path.resolve (mirroring src/db/repos.ts's own repo-path normalization) and checks the result stays within registeredRepoRoot, with no I/O either.
acceptanceChecks: PointerStalenessCheck returns {stale:false} when pointer.contentHash is absent, and compares currentContentHash against pointer.contentHash otherwise, with no file I/O
PointerPathValidator returns {ok:true, violations:[]} for an in-root path and {ok:false, violations:[...]} naming the escaping path for a '..'-escaping path, with no file I/O
Both functions are pure: identical inputs always produce identical ok/stale, varying only in any wall-clock field documented for that function

tests.name: PointerStalenessCheck and PointerPathValidator are exported with their documented signatures and are pure (no I/O)

tasks.title: Write unit tests for the new types and both functions
tasks.summary: Add flat kebab-case *.test.ts files under src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/ (matching this directory's existing one-concern-per-file convention) covering: Locator/Pointer shape + open-kind acceptance, PointerStalenessCheck's documented precondition/edge cases, and PointerPathValidator's in-root/escaping-path cases, per the LLD's testStrategy.
acceptanceChecks: Every subject named in the LLD's testStrategy.testLevels has a corresponding test case
ac1, ac2 and ac3's provingTests from the LLD's acceptanceMapping all pass
npx tsx --test for the new test files passes with zero failures

tests.name: a Pointer with path + section (Locator) identifies both the file and the region
a Pointer with no section still identifies the whole file
a Locator with kind='symbol'/'lineRange'/'docSection' is accepted
a Locator with an arbitrary future kind string is accepted and read via a non-exhaustive string-keyed lookup, not an exhaustive switch
PointerStalenessCheck returns stale:true when pointer.contentHash differs from currentContentHash
PointerStalenessCheck returns stale:false when pointer.contentHash equals currentContentHash
PointerStalenessCheck returns stale:false when pointer.contentHash is absent (no hash was ever recorded)
PointerStalenessCheck returns stale:true when pointer.contentHash is an empty string compared against a real hex digest
PointerStalenessCheck always returns the same stale value for the same two arguments (purity), only checkedAt varies
PointerPathValidator returns ok:true for a Pointer.path that resolves within registeredRepoRoot
PointerPathValidator returns ok:false with a named violation for a Pointer.path containing '..' segments that resolves outside registeredRepoRoot
